title: BusinessProcessDefinition - Tooling API
description: Represents information about stages in a customer lifecycle map. This object is available in API version 51.0 and later.

BusinessProcessGroupId.description: Unique identifier of the customer lifecycle map that is associated with the stage.

DeveloperName.description: Developer name of the stage. Note: Only users with View DeveloperName OR View Setup and Configuration permission can view, group, sort, and filter this field.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
